_meta.purpose: Target JSON shape for chat extraction output. Not a strict machine-enforced JSON Schema — a shape description for the model to follow.
_meta.visible_text_rule: Technical ids/enums may be English/latin only where the field is explicitly technical: section_code, target_code, group_code, zone_id, zone_kind, role, purpose, slab_kind, lintel_kind, component. Human-visible/source fields must be copied from the PDF as written, without translation or transliteration: raw_text, table_title, table_context, page_title, item_name, display_name, name, mark, slab_mark, source_label, context, source_phrase, lintel_id. If the PDF says Б1.1, ПР-2 or ПМ1, keep Б1.1, ПР-2, ПМ1; never rewrite them as B1.1, PR-2 or PM1.

raw_table_rows: raw_table_row, ... - table rows copied before target mapping
missing: target_code, ... - codes from calculator_targets_compact.json with no PDF evidence
needs_review: found_item, ... - subset of found items flagged for human review (also present in found)

extraction_warnings: string, ... - free-text notes about the PDF that don't fit elsewhere (e.g. 'page 8 table overlaps a drawing, low confidence')

found_item_shape.target_code: string - matches a target/group code from calculator_targets_compact.json, or a free-text label if outside the compact list
found_item_shape.group_code: string|null - set only for items belonging to an extract_groups entry (e.g. trench_routes, foundation_rebar_items)
found_item_shape.item_name: string|null - for group items, copied from PDF as written, e.g. route name 'К1' or rebar 'ф10 А500С'; do not translate/transliterate
found_item_shape.unit: string|null - unit as written in the PDF
found_item_shape.normalized_unit: string|null - from unit_normalization_guide.json; use 'mixed' only when group_code is set and the repeated row value has several fields with different units, never for scalar targets
found_item_shape.raw_text: string|null - verbatim quote or table cell description; keep PDF spelling, Cyrillic marks and Russian wording
found_item_shape.table_context: string|null - table title/header this value came from, if applicable; keep PDF spelling
found_item_shape.candidates: array|null - present only when there is genuine ambiguity between two or more values; each candidate has the same shape as found_item minus this field

raw_table_row_shape.table_id: string|null - stable local id within this extraction, e.g. 'floor_slab_formwork_table'
raw_table_row_shape.table_title: string|null - visible table title/header, copied from PDF as written
raw_table_row_shape.page_title: string|null - visible sheet/page title, copied from PDF as written
columns: string, ... - column headers as visible in the PDF
raw_table_row_shape.row_index: number|null - row order inside the table
cells: string|number|null, ... - raw cell values in the same order as columns
raw_table_row_shape.raw_text: string|null - full raw row text if cells are hard to separate
raw_table_row_shape.unit: string|null - unit as written in the table row/cell
raw_table_row_shape.normalized_unit: string|null - from unit_normalization_guide.json; 'mixed' is allowed here when one raw table row contains several numeric cells in different units
mapped_target_codes: string, ... - target codes this row was mapped to, or empty if only kept for context

communications_pipe_items.name: string
communications_pipe_items.total_length_m: number|null - only if explicitly present in PDF

foundation_rebar_items.name: string
foundation_rebar_items.source_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
foundation_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from 'Масса ед. шт.' or kg/m column when present
foundation_rebar_items.weight_kg: number|null - only if PDF explicitly prints this row's total kg/weight; do not calculate it from length x kg_per_meter

floor_slab_zones.zone_id: string - stable local id, not a project name
floor_slab_zones.display_name: string - slab name as shown in PDF/context; keep Russian wording and marks, do not translate/transliterate
floor_slab_zones.slab_mark: string|null - ПМ1/ПМ2/etc. if printed; keep Cyrillic/visible spelling
floor_slab_zones.slab_thickness_m: number|null - the slab's own concrete thickness, usually printed in the concrete spec row itself (e.g. 'толщиной 200мм' -> 0.2); real calculator input, not descriptive
floor_slab_zones.slab_edge_perimeter_m: number|null - slab's own outer edge length in m.p., control-geometry only
floor_slab_zones.concrete_slab_volume_m3: number|null - slab concrete only, not beams
floor_slab_zones.concrete_total_with_beams_m3: number|null - diagnostic/control only when PDF prints an explicit combined total
floor_slab_zones.formwork_edge_and_beam_combined_area_m2: number|null - only when PDF gives inseparable slab edge + beam formwork

floor_slab_eps_items.role: slab_bottom|slab_edge|combined_bottom_and_edge|unknown - slab EPS only; never beam/lintel insulation
floor_slab_eps_items.material_name: string|null - copied from PDF as written

floor_slab_beam_items.mark: string|null - beam mark copied from PDF as written; keep Б/П/ПР Cyrillic marks, do not transliterate
floor_slab_beam_items.name: string|null - beam name copied from PDF/context as written
floor_slab_beam_items.width_m: number|null - may be null for combined beam rows
floor_slab_beam_items.concrete_volume_m3: number|null - only if PDF gives this row's ready concrete volume
floor_slab_beam_items.formwork_area_m2: number|null - only if PDF gives this row's ready formwork area

floor_slab_rebar_items.name: string|null - copied from PDF as written
floor_slab_rebar_items.spec_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
floor_slab_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from 'Масса ед. шт.' or kg/m column when present; do not calculate total weight

floor_slab_additional_items.name: string - copied from PDF as written

roof_raw_material_spec_rows.name: string - copied from PDF as written

wall_zones.display_name: string - human-visible zone name copied from PDF/context as written; do not use zone_kind enum as display text
wall_zones.cutoff_waterproofing_area_m2: number|null - only for cutoff waterproofing under load-bearing walls, exclude partitions

wall_block_items.item_id: string|null - technical local id; may be latin, does not replace PDF text
wall_block_items.block_density: string|null - e.g. D400/D500, copy literal from PDF when visible
wall_block_items.block_size: string|null - e.g. 600x400x250, copy literal from PDF when visible
wall_block_items.context: string|null - source row context/subzone copied from PDF as written

wall_chasing_rebar_items.item_id: string|null - technical local id; may be latin, does not replace PDF text
wall_chasing_rebar_items.spec_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
wall_chasing_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from PDF kg/m column only; do not calculate total weight

lintel_items.lintel_id: string|null - lintel mark/type as printed when visible, e.g. ПР-2/ПБ1; do not transliterate

lintel_rebar_items.lintel_id: string|null - must match an actual lintel_items.lintel_id when the PDF spec gives rebar per individual lintel/mark. If the PDF gives rebar as one combined total for the whole zone/floor, not split by lintel or by lintel_kind, leave lintel_id null - do not invent a floor-level label (e.g. 'lintels of floor 1') as a substitute id; a null value here is expected and correctly routes to the zone's shared rebar pool.
lintel_rebar_items.item_id: string|null - technical local id; may be latin, does not replace PDF text
lintel_rebar_items.spec_length_m: number|null - primary PDF quantity when row unit is м/п
lintel_rebar_items.kg_per_meter: number|null - from PDF kg/m column only; do not calculate total weight
